data.title: 神罚 · 玫瑰泡沫的双人温存
data.description: 热气氤氲的宽大理石浴缸中，漂浮着绵密的玫瑰香氛泡沫。卸下武装的神罚羞怯又依恋地靠入你的怀中，任由你用温热清水细心洗涤她湿漉微卷的银发。
data.location: luxury private bathroom with steam and warm candlelight
data.action: soaking in large bubble-filled marble bathtub, wet silver hair, blushing sweetly, leaning back into embrace, soapy suds on wet skin
data.lighting: soft candlelight glowing through steamy vapor
data.promptProse: Soaking in a steamy bubble bath by candlelight, Modernia leans back with wet silver hair and blushing cheeks, savoring gentle pampering.
data.animaCaption: Modernia enjoying a steamy candlelit bubble bath with blushing cheeks.
